papers.title: Explainable Prediction of Medical Codes from Clinical Text
findings: PDF p1 identity and per-label motivation.
PDF pp2-3 sections2.1-2.3: sharedCNN H; per-label alpha=softmax(H^T u); separate linear label decoder and sigmoid.
PDF p3 section2.5: label-description regularization already discusses infrequent-label sharing.
limitations: Clinical multi-label task/CNN/BCE differ from frozen single-label Re-TACRED.
No whole-paper empirical verification or exhaustive novelty search; no public code inspected.

papers.title: A Label Attention Model for ICD Coding from Clinical Text
findings: PDF p1 identity; context-sensitive label attention motivation.
PDF p3 section3.1/Eqs4-6: Z=tanh(WH), row-softmax(UZ), V=HA^T; separate per-label binary readout.
PDF p3 discussion distinguishes label-specific heads from aggregated structured attention; section3.2 introduces ICD hierarchy.
limitations: BiLSTM training, ICD multi-label losses and supervised hierarchy differ from current model.
No architecture-wide containment, relative task-performance, complete literature coverage or code-equivalence claim.

papers.title: Relational Composition as Parallel Transport: What Per-Entity Frames Force in Attention
findings: p2 explicitly selects independent perentity frame freedom as inductive bias, not a consequence of fresh names.
p3Eq1/Theorems1-2 require covariant edge carriers and independent orthogonal endpoint frames.
p4Theorem3 requires orthogonal recurrence, finite target group, allword exactness and convexcell readout; p5 discusses readoutdependent width.
limitations: Preprint v1 only; no complete appendixproof or scientific experiment independently verified.
Current task/implementation does not supply the stated transport/recurrence/group assumptions.
